reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 6 points better, in a game of about 235 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Wizards.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 209 and 258 total points.

analyst.text: Washington are on a back-to-back and a six-game slide, with Trae Young describing 'a lot of mental things' behind it. Memphis are badly depleted: GG Jackson II suffered what Tuomas Iisalo called a 'relatively serious' foot injury in his contract year, on top of Ty Jerome and Jerami Grant being out. The angle leans only slightly towards the Grizzlies.
